description: This file defines the Date class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing date and time conversion utilities, format detection, and timezone management for spreadsheet date handling.

classes.name: Date
classes.description: Provides static methods for date and time conversions, format detection, and timezone management within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: setExcelCalendar
methods.description: Sets the base calendar year for date calculations (1900 or 1904).

methods.name: getExcelCalendar
methods.description: Returns the current base calendar year used for date calculations.

methods.name: setDefaultTimezone
methods.description: Sets the default timezone for date conversions.

methods.name: getDefaultTimezone
methods.description: Returns the default timezone, or UTC if not set.

methods.name: getDefaultOrLocalTimezone
methods.description: Returns the default timezone, or the local timezone if default is not set.

methods.name: getDefaultTimezoneOrNull
methods.description: Returns the default timezone, or null if not set.

methods.name: validateTimeZone
methods.description: Validates and converts a timezone input into a DateTimeZone object.

methods.name: convertIsoDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO-8601 date string to an Excel serialized timestamp.

methods.name: excelToDateTimeObject
methods.description: Converts an Excel serialized date/time value to a PHP DateTime object.

methods.name: excelToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts an Excel serialized date/time value to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: PHPToExcel
methods.description: Converts a PHP date value (DateTime, timestamp, or string) to an Excel serialized date/time value.

methods.name: dateTimeToExcel
methods.description: Converts a PHP DateTime object to an Excel serialized date/time value.

methods.name: timestampToExcel
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to an Excel serialized date/time value.

methods.name: formattedPHPToExcel
methods.description: Creates an Excel date/time value from individual date and time components.

methods.name: isDateTime
methods.description: Determines if a cell contains a date/time value based on its style and value.

methods.name: isDateTimeFormat
methods.description: Checks if a NumberFormat code is a date/time format.

methods.name: isDateTimeFormatCode
methods.description: Checks if a format code string is a date/time format.

methods.name: stringToExcel
methods.description: Converts a date string to an Excel serial date/time value.

methods.name: monthStringToNumber
methods.description: Converts a month name or abbreviation to its numeric representation.

methods.name: dayStringToNumber
methods.description: Removes ordinal suffix from a day string and converts to number.

methods.name: dateTimeFromTimestamp
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from a Unix timestamp with optional timezone.

methods.name: formattedDateTimeFromTimestamp
methods.description: Formats a Unix timestamp into a string with a specified format.
